page.overview:
What is Aaamazzara?

Aaamazzara was an inhabited planet in the Epsilon Serpentis system. Located in the Alpha Quadrant, this planet was the homeworld of the Aaamazzarites and was approximately 72 light years from Sol.

In the 24th century, Commander , a crewmember aboard the , was born on this non-Federation planet. In 2369, his planet of origin was listed on the chart "USS Enterprise Personnel Database", which was displayed on a accessed by Captain Jean-Luc Picard. (, okudagram)

In the 32nd century, Aaamazzara was a Federation member planet. It was listed with other members on a video wall in the . ()

In the 3191, this planet's special designation as a homeworld was noted on a star chart. ()
